title: Partition Array For Maximum Sum
description: Partition the array into subarrays of length at most k such that the sum of each subarray is replaced by its maximum value.
pseudocode:
1. dp = new Array(n + 1).fill(0)
2. for i from 1 to n:
3.   currMax = 0
4.   for j from 1 to k and i - j >= 0:
5.     currMax = max(currMax, arr[i - j])
6.     dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[i - j] + currMax * j)

steps.note: Initialize DP table of size n+1 with zeros.
Calculating max for subarray ending at 1 (k=3). currMax = 1.
Calculating max for subarray ending at 2. currMax = 4.
Final DP state update for i=3 using optimal partition.
